'''Helvan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Special Intelligence]] operative cell leader of the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]]. He was assigned to Intelligence agent [[Kirtan Loor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap" />
